description: This file defines interfaces for system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and notification mechanisms.
external_files: assuming Core::IUnknown is declared in core/IUnknown.h or similar
external_methods: assumed to be part of Core::IUnknown

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Main interface for accessing and managing various system subsystems and their states, including notifications and version info.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for subsystem status changes.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem details, including callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity details, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location information such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details, including architecture, chipset, firmware version, and identifier.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IProvisioning
classes.description: Interface for provisioning data, supporting iteration over stored info.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IDecryption
classes.description: Interface for decryption subsystem info, supporting iteration over status entries.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version number.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when a subsystem change occurs.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the security subsystem's callsign.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the public IP address of the device.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts network_type enum to string representation.

methods.name: TimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone of the device.

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Returns the country of the device.

methods.name: Region
methods.description: Returns the region of the device.

methods.name: City
methods.description: Returns the city of the device.

methods.name: Latitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude coordinate.

methods.name: Longitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude coordinate.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Fills buffer with device identifier bytes.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Returns the architecture string.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset string.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version string.

methods.name: TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the current time synchronization status.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Returns provisioning storage info.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances iterator to next info entry.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves iterator to previous info entry.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets iterator to specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns total number of info entries.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns current info entry.
